// Generator for the parity goldens. It renders each case with the OLD renderer: copy this
// file into internal/connector/local of a checkout of main (the live build's source) as
// parity_gen_test.go and run
//
//	CERBERUS_PARITY_CASES=<this testdata/parity dir> go test -run TestGenerateParityGoldens ./internal/connector/local
//
// It writes <case>/unit.golden next to each resource.yaml. Do not commit it to main.
package local

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"

	"github.com/hollis-labs/cerberus/internal/config"
	"github.com/hollis-labs/cerberus/internal/domain"
)

func TestGenerateParityGoldens(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("CERBERUS_PARITY_CASES")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("CERBERUS_PARITY_CASES unset")
	}
	cases, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*", "resource.yaml"))
	if len(cases) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("no cases")
	}
	b := systemdBackend{
		homeDir:  func() (string, error) { return "/u/op", nil },
		envPath:  func() string { return "/u/op/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" },
		selfPath: func() (string, error) { return "/u/op/.local/bin/cerberus", nil },
	}
	for _, p := range cases {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(p)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var r config.ResourceDef
		if err := yaml.Unmarshal(raw, &r); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		res := &domain.Resource{ID: r.ID, Name: r.Name, Type: domain.ResourceType(r.Type), ProjectID: r.Project, Connector: r.Connector, Config: r.Config}
		spec, err := SpecFromResourceConfig(res.Config)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", p, err)
		}
		layout, err := b.layout(res, spec)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", p, err)
		}
		unit, err := b.renderUnit(res, spec, layout)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", p, err)
		}
		out := append([]byte("# unit: "+layout.UnitName+"\n"), unit...)
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(p), "unit.golden"), out, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
